primary_choice: User selected unchanged CARLsim refractory/reset semantics; immediate-reset ODE diagnostic only.
source_identity_check: Hashes correspond to repository synapse_dynamics_v2.json changed source map; actual library not executed in this experiment.
units: ms,mV,pA; refractory counter decremented on lastIter,once per1ms tick. This is a tick counter,not fractional substep duration.
semantics: Manager sets Izh_ref=1 regardless of supplied integer; archived row also1.
At substep start load v=voltage,v_next=nextVoltage,u=recovery. Strict previous v_next>Vpeak check occurs before smooth integration. Crossing inside a substep is detected at the next substep boundary.
When counter>0,suppress BOTH voltage and recovery updates. On lastIter,decrement counter and clamp v_next=Vmin.
Otherwise when v_next>Vpeak,set curSpike=true,v_next=Vmin,u+=d; set counter1 on lastIter or2 otherwise; skip ODE integration in reset substep.
Otherwise RK4 integrates full substep with float32 model state; lower voltage clamp-90mV applies.

For dt=1/Nms,reset at substep j leaves integration suppressed through end of current tick (if j<N-1) and all of following tick. At j=N-1,it sets1 and next full tick is suppressed. First resumed integration occurs at start of next tick after counter reaches0. Thus refractory duration measured from reset is grid-phase dependent ~1..2ms,not simply exactly1ms.
Spike monitor timestamps are1ms. Numerical verification must instrument/compare true substep state and crossing/reset records separately.
verification_status: Source inspection and independent review only;not spike/reset numerical validation.
